name: Creality CR-30 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; === Creality CR-30 3DPrintMill belt start (adapted from stock PrintMill g-code) ===
; Machine axes: X=lateral  Y=nozzle gap above belt  Z=belt advance
G90 ; absolute positioning
M82 ; absolute extrusion
G21 ; metric values
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; start heating hotend
M140 S[hot_plate_temp_initial_layer] ; start heating belt
G28 X Y ; home X and gantry (Y)
G92 Z0 E0 ; zero belt and extruder
G1 Y2 F2000 ; move gantry off the belt
G28 X0 F2000 ; home X
G1 X200 Z5 F4000 ; move X to centre, advance belt slightly
; --- sensorless belt probe: drop Y motor current so the nozzle stalls on contact ---
M908 P5 S10 ; Y1 motor current off
M908 P1 S10 ; Y2 motor current off
G1 Y20 F3000 ; move gantry up
M400 ; wait for moves to finish
M908 P5 S25 ; Y1 motor current very low
M908 P1 S25 ; Y2 motor current very low
G1 Y0 F500 ; lower gantry until nozzle touches belt
M400 ; wait for moves to finish
M908 P5 S140 ; Y1 motor current back to normal
M908 P1 S140 ; Y2 motor current back to normal
G92 Y0 ; belt contact = Y0 (first-layer datum)
M190 S[hot_plate_temp_initial_layer] ; wait for belt temp
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; wait for hotend temp
; --- purge across the belt, advancing Z between passes ---
G1 Y2 F2000 ; gantry off the belt
G1 F15000 ; high feedrate
G1 X200 Y1 E10 ; extrude 10mm and move to the side
G1 Z10 E12 F500
G1 X0 E32
G1 Z20 E34
G1 X200 E54
G1 Z30 E56 F500
G1 X0 E76
G1 Z40 E78
G1 X200 E98
G1 X0 Z40.2 E120
G92 E0 Z0 ; zero extruder and belt - print starts here
G1 E-4 F3900 ; retract 4mm at 65mm/s
machine_end_gcode:
; === Creality CR-30 belt end (stock PrintMill g-code) ===
G92 E0 ; zero extruder
G1 E-6 F1800 ; retract 6mm
G92 Z0 ; zero belt
G1 Z15 F1000 ; advance belt 15mm before the next product
G92 Z0 ; zero belt again
M104 S0 ; hotend heater off
M140 S0 ; belt heater off
M106 S0 ; part cooling fan off
M106 P1 S0 ; rear/aux fan off
G92 Z0
G1 Z20 F1000 ; advance belt to release the part
G28 X0 F2000 ; home X only (never G28 all - rewinds the belt)
G1 Y10 F2000 ; lift gantry clear
M18 ; disable all steppers
